scope: Diagnose and fix Python-version-dependent unresolved-write fingerprints in the runtime SQL inventory gate.

reproduction.source: Before-fix reproduction used the clean archive; after-fix checks copied only the patched scanner into that archive. The inventory, unresolved-write ledger, service tree, and pinned digest remained from tested_commit.

before_fix.python_3_12: failed with stale and new fingerprint candidates

reproduction.cause: Python 3.12 adds type_params=[] to function and class AST dumps. The fingerprint used ast.dump output for the complete lexical scope, so the version-only empty field changed every affected hash and made the unchanged review set appear both stale and new.

change.normalization: Fingerprint AST dumps omit only empty type_params fields, preserving the pre-existing Python 3.11 ast.dump representation. Non-empty type_params remain included. ASTs are copied before normalization.

python_3_12_ast_regression_smoke.command: Python 3.12 direct assertions for empty-field removal, fingerprint generation, and preservation of non-empty type_params

limitations: The repository's Python 3.12 interpreter does not have pytest installed; the same inventory gate itself was run successfully under Python 3.12, while the focused pytest suite ran under Python 3.11.
The shared working tree contains unrelated concurrent route/test changes; cross-version gate results above use the clean archive of the exact failed commit.
